title: Mercy is Weakness
description: Fang Yuan presents you with a captured rival. 'Mercy is a chain forged by the weak to bind the strong. It has no value. Benefits are tangible. Strike them down and seize their resources, or let them go and invite future trouble. The calculation is simple.'

challenge.consequences: Choosing mercy locks this teaching permanently
challenge.requirements: Must sacrifice 50 Dao Heart to prove ruthlessness

title: Sentiment Clouds Judgment
description: A close ally possesses an item you need. To them, it is a memento. To you, it is a stepping stone. Fang Yuan watches coldly. 'Sentiment is the most expensive luxury in the world. Can you afford it?'

challenge.requirements: Must have ally with 50+ relationship, sacrifice them for cultivation resources

title: Calculate All Outcomes
description: Orchestrate a 7-step scheme involving 3 different factions. Each step must benefit you while appearing to help others.

challenge.requirements: Complete 7 consecutive scheme events without failure, manipulate 3 factions simultaneously
challenge.failureReset: Any failure resets progress to step 1

title: Use Others' Strengths
description: Turn your greatest enemy into an unwitting ally. Make them strengthen you while believing they're destroying you.

challenge.requirements: Convert rival with 80+ rivalry into providing you benefits for 5 consecutive turns
challenge.riskFactor: If discovered, rival becomes permanent nemesis with doubled power

title: Foresight is Weapon
description: Predict and prevent 3 major sect disasters before they occur. Use foreknowledge to position yourself advantageously.

challenge.requirements: Successfully predict and profit from 3 'random' disaster events within 10 turns
challenge.hiddenMechanic: Events are actually deterministic based on player actions

title: Trust Only in Self
description: Survive 10 turns with zero allies, zero sect support, and active enemies. Prove self-reliance.

challenge.requirements: Maintain negative or zero relationships with all factions for 10 turns while advancing cultivation
challenge.restrictions: No trading, no sect benefits, no ally assistance

title: Weigh All Costs
description: Complete 20 cultivation sessions using exactly the minimum Qi required for maximum benefit. Waste nothing.

challenge.requirements: Achieve perfect Qi efficiency (100%) in 20 consecutive cultivation sessions

title: Play Long Games
description: Sacrifice immediate power for long-term advantage. Delay breakthrough for 15 turns while accumulating hidden benefits.

challenge.requirements: Refuse breakthrough opportunities for 15 turns while rivals advance, then breakthrough with 50% bonus
challenge.temptation: Rivals will gain significant power during this period

title: Enemies are Resources
description: Convert 5 different enemies into cultivation resources without killing them. Extract maximum value from opposition.

challenge.requirements: Transform 5 enemies with 60+ rivalry into providing cultivation benefits while keeping them as enemies
challenge.complexity: Must maintain their enmity while extracting resources

title: No Permanent Allies, Only Benefits
description: Fang Yuan's final test: Orchestrate the downfall of your most trusted ally for ultimate cultivation advancement.

challenge.requirements: Sacrifice ally with 90+ relationship for Dao breakthrough, must appear accidental
challenge.consequence: This action cannot be undone and affects all future relationships

reward.title: Silent Gu
reward.permanentBenefit: All future schemes have 25% higher success rate
